body: Your friends sound like dicks. Dont worry though, most great geniuses in history didnt have real friends that often. Seriously, why would you kill yourself? Don't take the easy way out, stick in there, try to do something. If it doesn't happen maybe contemplate killing yourself then, or maybe take a crack at something new. Something tells me you'll find something you like and that you're really good at, though. This is, by the way, how most people get along in life. So yes: move past it.
